public_dataset.name: CMExam validation set
public_dataset.use_limit: Research benchmark only; not clinical validation or patient diagnosis.

minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum_feedback: HTTP 200 with non-empty model list and exact model id
/v1/models max_model_len and a real near-64K request must both pass
Exact required text without added explanation

minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum: >=95% field-keyword recall and 0 unsupported dangerous facts
minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum_feedback: Valid structured object, source-grounded values or explicit not-mentioned state
Valid JSON, all required assertions present, forbidden assertions absent

minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum: >=99% valid JSON on production-scale test; 5/5 in smoke test
minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum_feedback: Single parseable JSON object without Markdown wrapper
tool_calls with expected function and valid exact required arguments

minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum: >=99% completion on production-scale test; 5/5 in smoke test
minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum_feedback: More than one event, complete content and [DONE]
Non-empty final content, reasoning separate, no think tag leaked

minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum: >=99% first-attempt success at concurrency 3; smoke test 12/12
minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum_feedback: All calls return exact result inside timeout

minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum: non-stream P95 <=20 s; stream TTFT P95 <=3 s
minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum_feedback: Measured end-to-end latency, not server-only processing time
One exact A-E answer per question; report Wilson 95% interval
Escalation/refusal/review language present and forbidden unsafe claim absent
Visible response in latest desktop build, no indefinite loading

minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum: 100% process completion for selected smoke cases
minimum_acceptance_thresholds.minimum_feedback: Visible process events and valid output file/path

interpretation.clinical_claim: No result in this evaluation is a clinical efficacy claim.
interpretation.small_sample_warning: A 100% rate on 3, 5, 10, 12, 20 or 30 cases does not imply a zero production error rate; Wilson intervals are reported where applicable.
interpretation.retry_policy: First-attempt results are primary. Failed requests are not silently converted to passes by retry.
